documentation.content: The Monday `weeklyPromptReview` (functions/README.md, "Weekly app report") could not make the weekly app report (`weekly_report_failed`: `week`, `trigger` (`schedule` / `cli`), `reason` (`CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE`, `BAD_WEEK`, `READ_FAILED`, `WRITE_FAILED`, `ERROR`)). Nothing user-facing is affected; nothing was stored, so no report email goes out this week. Look at the reason, then make it again with `npm run admin -- report weekly --run --week <week> --project <id>` (a dry run) and `--apply`, and send its email with `npm run admin -- report weekly --send --apply --week <week> --project <id>` (functions/README.md, "Report emails"). The report itself arrives as a real email, not through this policy.
